wayForward: Treat recognition as an entry point for visibility, not as proof of completed inclusion.
Build accessible sports infrastructure, coaching, equipment, finance, and competition pathways based on documented needs.
Use measurable indicators such as accessibility, participation, retention, and progression to evaluate inclusion.
Ensure public communication preserves dignity and avoids reducing persons with disabilities to inspirational symbols alone.
